name: Generation Arcade
author: wspRocky
description: TFly a bit above the spikes that are above the wave portal at 22% and then release to continue playing through the level as the ship. Play through the following gameplay as the ship until 27% where you need to fly between the two cube portals. Continue navigating through the gameplay as the ship until 30% where after touching the mini portal you can hold below the level between the structures. Stay slightly below the gameplay (you can fall onto the black blacks from 40%-44%) until 56% where you can stay at a constant position near the bottom of the screen. Fall up at 61% until you land on the black blocks where you can then stay slightly below the gameplay whilst navigating around the obstacles until 81% where you can touch the first blue pad to become normal gravity, stay slightly below the gameplay and then fall to the floor at 84%. Move up, above the gameplay at 93%. Stay above the gameplay (on the floor) for the rest of the level.
